consumer: The frontend HP-bar renderer asking 'how full, and what color (green/yellow/red), should this visible monster's bar be shown as?' — a formatted/filtered display of hp vs hp_max gated by visibility.
scope: Only monsters the avatar can currently see (the seen-filtered set per Creature::sees), rendered as a display view — not the raw all-monsters world state.
decisive_source: src/creature.cpp::Creature::sees gates which monsters appear at all; src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities exposes mon.get_hp()/get_hp_max() whose ratio the GUI maps to a green/yellow/red tier purely to drive what is DISPLAYED — a display proxy, not a value any engine condition/mission/dialogue consumes.
divergence: A monster at 10% HP standing just outside the avatar's line of sight: raw simulation state holds it at low HP, but the correct display answer is to show NO bar (it is unseen) or a stale last-seen view — an implementation that emits its current low-HP colored bar from raw all-monsters state would be exposed as the wrong (non-display) authority.
